tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: World token. Top stop of the room's sky gradient. Room palettes inside a world may shift the stops; spikes stay 3:1 against every stop.

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: World token. Middle stop of the sky gradient, at 55% of the room height.

tokens.name: sky-bottom
tokens.usage: World token. Bottom stop of the sky gradient. Floor spikes sit on it, so it is usually the hardest contrast stop.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: World token. The world's one light source (sun, moon, lamp): one soft bloom that fades from glow-inner opacity at the centre to nothing at its edge, never over spikes.

tokens.name: spike
tokens.usage: World token. Every hazard silhouette: wall, ceiling and floor spikes, saws, spike blocks. 3:1 or more against all three sky stops. The only colour that means danger.

tokens.name: spike-edge
tokens.usage: World token. Light half of a smooth spike and the rim on moving hazards. Decoration: never the only thing that shows a hazard.

tokens.name: world-accent
tokens.usage: World token. The world's highlight: the room-change flash. Never used for text.

tokens.name: trail
tokens.usage: World token. Head colour of the default trail in this world, fading to transparent. Shop trails bring their own colours.

tokens.name: particle
tokens.usage: World token. Ambient particles (dust, pollen, snow, embers, bubbles, sprinkles, stars), low opacity, behind spikes.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: UI token. Deepest ink: the scrim base and the letterbox around the play area.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: UI token. The one dark ink: icons, the round primary button, the selected tab, slider fills. Never drawn as an outline around UI: the minimal kit has no outlines.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: UI token. Minimal kit: cream paper, the fill of cards (grids, forms, popups, the settings sheet), tab bars and secondary buttons. Flat: no outline, no drop.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: UI token. Pressed cards and buttons on panel.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: UI token. Soft edge: empty slider tracks, switch tracks, inactive toggles, divider lines and the In use ring's background. Never text.

tokens.name: on-panel
tokens.usage: UI token. Text and icons on paper (panel 14:1).

tokens.name: on-panel-muted
tokens.usage: UI token. Secondary text on paper: blurbs, captions, Owned (5:1 or more on panel and panel-raised).

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: UI token. Text and numbers drawn straight on the room (titles, wordmark, score, captions), dark ink with no outline. Rooms too dark for it (night worlds) switch to on-scrim; UiTheme picks per world.

tokens.name: on-scrim
tokens.usage: UI token. Text and icons over the dimmed room (pause, practice crash, popups' scrim) and on night rooms.

tokens.name: score-ghost
tokens.usage: UI token. The huge live score behind the bird: white at 50%, so it still shows on light skies without covering spikes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: UI token. The one main action per screen: a 100px round ink button (Play, Again, Resume, Practice) and the flat Unlock and Save buttons. No bottom edge.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: UI token. Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: UI token. Gold highlight: the Wild exit, the New best ribbon, your own leaderboard row. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: UI token. Text and icons on action (gold).

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: UI token. Coin icon fill. Coin amounts are ink text.

tokens.name: coin-edge
tokens.usage: UI token. Coin rim and the ribbon's folded tails.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: UI token. The Calm dot and small success marks, always with ink text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: UI token. Errors and destructive actions; on panel 5:1 or more. Never used for spikes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: UI token. Focus ring for keyboard and controller navigation, 3px outside the element.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: UI token. Dims the room behind pause, popups, the settings sheet and the practice crash (ink-900 at 62%, so white text keeps 4.5:1 even over a white sky).

styles.name: score-ghost
styles.usage: The live score centred behind the bird, in score-ghost.

styles.name: score-final
styles.usage: The score on Game over, straight on the room.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Big titles on the dimmed room: Paused, Crashed.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Screen titles next to the back arrow: Customize, Rooms, Leaderboards.

styles.name: number-m
styles.usage: Coin counts, prices, ranks. Tabular figures.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bounce wall to wall and keep away from the spikes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Secondary info on panels, setting names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under items. The smallest size for sentences.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase badges only: NEW, LIMITED, OWNED, PREMIUM.

type.note: One family, Archivo (variable: wght 100-900, wdth 62-125). Display = weight 900 at width 125 (wordmark, titles, scores); UI = width 100 at 600-800.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; icon to text in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside list rows; between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter (plus safe area); card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between buttons in a stack.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: HUD top offset under the status bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large gaps on menus (logo to Play).

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Tags, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards: grid tiles, popups, the settings sheet. Pictures inside a card use 16-18px.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Room pictures on Room detail.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tab bars, toggles, sliders, round buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and controller focus, in ink. The minimal kit has no drop shadows: cards and buttons are flat.

size.note: Logical pixels in the 360 x 640 game viewport; Godot scales them per phone.

tokens.name: viewport-w
tokens.usage: Logical width of the play area.

tokens.name: viewport-h
tokens.usage: Logical height of the play area.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable area: HUD buttons, close buttons.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Height of flat full-width buttons in popups (Unlock, Save name).

tokens.name: round-button
tokens.usage: The one main action per screen: a round ink button with its icon and name.

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills and tags.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: bird
tokens.usage: Drawn character size. The hitbox is 28px for every character.

tokens.name: spike-depth
tokens.usage: Drawn wall-spike depth (hitbox 26px).

tokens.name: spike-base
tokens.usage: Drawn wall-spike base (hitbox 30px).

tokens.name: glow-outer
tokens.usage: Edge of the glow bloom's bright core (the bloom fades to 0 past it).

tokens.name: glow-inner
tokens.usage: Centre of the world's glow bloom.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Soft light patches and background props.

tokens.name: spike-shade
tokens.usage: Black over the dark half of a smooth spike.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Locked items and disabled buttons, always with a lock icon or a price.
